# Albums

> Albums (albums.ink) collects wedding and event photos from guests: they
> scan a QR code and upload straight from the phone browser — no app to
> install, no signup. No per-guest limits, everything exports as
> one archive, and guests keep their shots in their own free account. Albums
> also turns photos, videos and voice notes into story albums with chapters
> and narration. Privacy is built in: an album can be public, friends-only
> or private. Free plan; Pro is $9.99/month; an Event Album is a one-time
> payment from $39.99.

Albums is not a photo host and not a feed. The unit of content is the album:
a curated collection with chapters, captions and the author's voice, read
like a story.

## What it does

- Story albums: chapters, ordered media, a voice note on any photo, slideshow
  playback with narration.
- Event albums (weddings, trips, birthdays, corporate events): one QR code
  for all guests, uploads from the phone browser without registration,
  a live photo wall for the venue screen, full export as a single archive.
  A guest who signs in keeps every uploaded shot in an album of their own,
  in their own free account — uploading is keeping, not giving away.
- Posts feed: a second surface with photo/video posts and carousels.
- Privacy: each album is public, private, friends-only, or friends-except-
  selected. Media live in a private bucket and are served via signed URLs —
  a private album cannot be opened by guessing a link.
- Interface in 9 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese,
  Korean, Russian, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese.

## Pricing

- Free — story albums with core features.
- Pro — $9.99/month.
- Event Album — three sizes, one-time per event, taxes included.
  Small — 100 GB, $39.99; Medium — 200 GB, $69.99; Large — 400 GB, $129.99;
  recommended for about 100, 250 and 500 guests. The guest number is only a
  guide: guests and uploads are not counted or limited, and each guest can
  upload any number of times; storage is the only limit, and more space can
  be added if it runs out. Files are stored for 6 months from the first
  upload (not from the payment), and the owner can extend storage by another
  6 months. An unused purchase does not expire. Guests never pay.
